items.title: Denison begins full-scale construction at Phoenix ISR uranium mine (DNN:NYSE)
items.blurb: Denison Mines said it has launched full-scale construction activities at its Phoenix In-Situ Recovery uranium mine in Saskatchewan.

items.title: Framatome Secures NRC Approval to Enrich Uranium to 10% at Richland
items.blurb: The NRC authorizes Framatome to enrich uranium up to 10% at its Richland site, a step toward TRISO and HALEU fuels.
